name: Road to De Other Side Normal trash hits a level 25 player like Vaults of the Inquisition, not like Mythic
contract: Road to De Other Side (map 937) has Heroic/Mythic templates at +100000/+200000, and its Normal templates are fitted at level 25: on live (2026-09 logs, same tank, level 10 creatures) Road hit like Vaults, so the Road targets are the 2026-09 Road medians times the Vaults June/September ratio (9.27): Interstitial Wanderer (162765) 111 and Spider of the Other Side (162770) 46. A class 1 creature of level 60 deals 40.8 per point of DamageModifier to a level 25 viewer (see vaults-normal-melee-level-25); spawned creatures take CoA.CreatureScaling.Dungeon.Damage (x1.5) on top, which this player-summoned fixture does not, so it hits for the target / 1.5 and the Normal templates carry 1.818 and 0.758. DestinyWeaver scales Road's Normal tier with finder entry 402 (band 15-59).

steps.label: CONTROL: the player is in Road to De Other Side
Interstitial Wanderer hits a level 25 player for about 74 before the dungeon x1.5 (111 on a real spawn)
Spider of the Other Side hits a level 25 player for about 31 before the dungeon x1.5 (46 on a real spawn)
